      public int getHeaderMinSize()
      Return the minimum ZCL Header Size, that is the ZCL Header size when the ZCLFrame is not manufacturer specific. This information is avaiable in the ZCL specification and must be written in the TCK configuration file.
      Returns:
      the requested information.
